mode.label: Background type
mode.desc: Auto looks at the image border: a checkerboard if there is one, otherwise the most common color.

color.label: Background color
color.picking: Click the “Before” image in the preview to sample a color.

checkerCellSize.label: Checker cell size
checkerCellSize.desc: Size of one checkerboard square. Leave on auto unless detection fails.

fill.label: Remove
fill.desc: From edges keeps background-colored areas inside the object (e.g. white eyes); Everywhere removes every matching pixel.

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.desc: How different a pixel may be from the background and still be removed.

metric.label: Color distance
metric.desc: Lab matches colors the way the eye sees them; RGB is faster and stricter.

feather.label: Feather
feather.desc: Soft alpha ramp along the cut edge (0 = hard edge).

defringe.label: Defringe
defringe.desc: Removes the white/colored halo left on anti-aliased edges.

preview.noFile: Add an image to see the preview
